There is now a new Version of the beloved Orbs Mode:

Have fun

notes.title: NEW! Single-Player Mode Orbs
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31601128/0caa92f5c69e56893bddae7bcfe928b9f03f196e.gif[/img]

Good News!

You now have another Single-player mode to play with:

[b]Collect the Orbs[/b]


Just try to get all the Orbs before they disappear into thin air (or turn to zero bits). Get the highest score possible. And don't forget: Pics / Vids or it did not happen!

Have fun ;)

hOSHI*

notes.title: Controller support added (Steam Link)
notes.notes:
Good news!

Now you can also play with one or two Game-Pads. That means, [b]hOSHIs Elektronauts[/b] is now even usable in [b]Big Picture Mode[/b] and with [b]Steam Controller[/b] and [b]Steam Link[/b].

Have fun ;)

hOSHI*

notes.title: NEW! Single-Player Mode Survival
notes.notes:
Hey,
I've seen a few Users and Youtubers playing hOSHIs Elektronauts in "Single-Player-Two-Handed-Suicide-Paint"-Mode. Of course, it was just the Multiplayer Mode.

So I decided to add a real Single-Player Mode:

[b]Survival Mode[/b]

Just stay alive as long as you can. The faster Speed the more Points you get!

Have fun - or scream if you like ;)

Greetings

hOSHI*
